text:
The plate looks like a square dinner plate of about 26 cm, so I used that as the ruler. Two cheese pizza pieces sit on it.

- **Upper piece:** about 11 cm long and 6 cm wide at its widest. As a triangular wedge, that is roughly 35 cm² of footprint. At about 0.8 cm thick, it weighs around 45 g.
- **Lower piece:** about 9 cm by 6 cm, so a bit smaller at roughly 30 cm². It weighs around 40 g.

Together that is about 85 g of thin-crust cheese pizza, which I counted as one item at about 270 kcal per 100 g.
